response.sql: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS avg_across_ratings FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(r.avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(r.avg_price_per_day - o.avg_across_ratings) AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM rating_prices AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.avg_price_per_day > o.avg_across_ratings
